It offers systems integration and application management; security; intelligent platform; infrastructure; software engineering; data, AI, cloud; and automation and global delivery services. The company also operates business processes for specific enterprise functions, including finance and accounting, sourcing and procurement, supply chain, marketing and sales, and human resources, as well as industry-specific services, such as platform trust and safety, banking, insurance, network and health services; and designs, manufactures, and assembles automation equipment, robotics, and other commercial hardware products. It serves communications, media, and technology; financial services; banking and capital markets, and insurance; health and public service; consumer goods, retail, travel services; industrial; life science; and chemicals, natural resources, energy, and utilities sectors. risks.title: Cyberattacks and Data Security
risks.summary: Accenture faces significant risks from cyberattacks that could compromise client data and its own infrastructure, with a potentially material impact on operating results.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is presented first in the Risk Factors section and identified as potentially having a future material impact. The language emphasizes the constantly evolving and increasingly sophisticated nature of cyber threats. Dedicated governance with a CISO, an active Audit Committee, and reporting to the Board at least twice a year reinforces the critical importance of this exposure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Security Incidents and Reputational Risk
risks.summary: A security incident could severely damage Accenture's reputation, affecting client trust and key business relationships.
risks.score_rationale: The link between data security and reputational risk is implicit but strong, particularly through Board-level exposure and regular escalation protocols. Although not materialized to date, the recurring nature of the topic in quarterly Audit Committee reports indicates high vigilance, critical for IT services. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Economic Risks
risks.summary: Global economic and geopolitical uncertainty affects client demand and spending on transformation IT services, negatively impacting regional operations.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned implicitly in the risk management context, with concrete effects on operating results. Global economic uncertainty affects client demand and order cycles. Direct impact on cloud and AI transformation projects. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks and Currency Exposure
risks.summary: Exposure to foreign currency fluctuations could affect operating results, although hedging strategies are in place to mitigate this risk.
risks.score_rationale: Accenture is exposed to foreign currency fluctuations in its global operations, with hedges in place on major pairs USD/JPY, USD/INR, EUR, GBP, AUD, CHF, PHP, CNY. A 10% change in exchange rates would have impacted the fair value of hedging instruments by 722 million dollars as of August 31, 2025. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Leadership Continuity and Key Talent
risks.summary: Executive leadership continuity is crucial for strategy execution; recent transitions in regional CEO roles could affect execution.
risks.score_rationale: Executive leadership has undergone significant changes in September 2024 and 2025, with transitions at the regional CEO and strategic leadership levels. Operational continuity is managed by experienced teams, but leadership stability remains an important factor. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Contractual Obligations and Asset Impairment Risks
risks.summary: Significant contractual commitments for cloud and IT services create predictable but managed cash outflows in the ordinary course of operations.
risks.score_rationale: Accenture has commitments of 3 billion dollars for cloud hosting and IT services, of which 1.154 billion to be fulfilled within 12 months. These obligations are managed and non-cancellable, but represent a mandatory cash flow. (default score, to be refined)
